scope: Research and to-do audit of the Hop catalogue (modern Rechov Sumsum, short series and the Israeli Elmo talk show) and of the Sesame Stories series Hop! broadcast in 2003-2004. Version 2 aligns the audit with data/episode-guide.json. Its research loaded no Hop HTML page by script. On 2026-10-18 the Hop collector read the 234 manifest pages in Zen Home through the Hop-only Proton rule to collect their Vimeo links. No VPN setting changed and no media was downloaded.

definitions.published_complete_short_installment: Official per-video title explicitly claims a complete installment of a short series; not a complete core magazine broadcast.
definitions.whole_upload_candidate: Named narrative or standalone program upload; original program identity and completeness still unverified.
definitions.parts_only: A segment, song, interview, word or extract; not counted as a whole main broadcast. This does not assert that the standalone segment itself is truncated.
definitions.collection_not_episode: Compilation, excluded from episode identity denominators.
definitions.identity: A named content identity. Certain alternate hosts count once. Unresolved matching remains explicit and cannot inflate known episode totals.
definitions.acquire-canonical-inventory-and-whole-br: Count-based acquisition task for an announced season, with unknown canonical titles and numbering. It creates no invented episode identities.
definitions.guideStatus: How the identity appears in data/episode-guide.json: episode (a guide episode), awaiting-identification (in the production queue), segment (not an episode), not-in-guide (outside the guide productions).
definitions.segment_awaiting_episode: A story file that belongs to a season but is shorter than its accounted episode length; its broadcast episode is not identified.

revisionHistory.summary: Initial audit of 237 Hop host records.

Aligned with the episode guide: documented season totals (2006: 40, Hop! 2007 page; 2012: 15, DVD set), the 2012 DVD order of episodes 1-10, 26 Sesame Stories titles from Hop!'s 2004 schedule, per-story quotes from archived 2015 Hop! pages, regulator page corrections, hop-yt--ajWXnyBJ5I identified as Guri Alfi, hop-5096 moved to Discovering Curiosity, the 2009 story files and the two experiment films reclassified as segments, Elmo and We love you, Elmo numbering evidence, and 49 new Hop posts awaiting Vimeo collection.

Review corrections: production counters recomputed from identities[] (Elmo 28 of 28 mapped, Discovering Curiosity 13 of 13, other specials 4 of 4); the top-level input hashes labelled as version-1 inputs (commit 011a072); asset kinds follow the records, so the 2009 story files and hop-5082 are clips; notOnHop lists all five removed items; Hop!'s 'סיפורי סומסום' clip group is left unresolved against the 2003 Sesame Stories series, with a task to compare it with Classicaletet's DVD.

Hop Vimeo collection: all 234 manifest pages returned a Vimeo link on 2026-10-18; the 49 new posts have exact URLs and running times. 224 distinct videos: 10 new posts are second listings of catalogued videos, and four of them are linked as excerpts like their twins. newHopPostsAwaitingVimeoCollection renamed newHopPosts; collection task resolved.

newHopPosts.note: Found through Hop!'s public wp-json API on 2026-10-17. Their pages were outside the original 185-page manifest; on 2026-10-18 they were appended to data/hop-url-manifest.json and to the collector manifest in scripts/collect-hop-links.js (234 pages in each). 42 are posts of the separate "music" type at /music/ paths. On 2026-10-18 an agent ran the collector in Zen Home at the user's request, through the Proton extension on Israel, Tel Aviv (IL#751) with the Hop-only Include rule. All 234 manifest pages, the 42 /music/ pages among them, returned a Vimeo player link, with no region block, error or retry. Each of the 49 new rows in data/hop-player-links.json keeps its privacy hash. Public Vimeo oEmbed metadata gave a running time for each. Playback of these links was not tested.

vimeoComparison.note: Ten music posts embed the same Vimeo video as a catalogued show post, so the 49 posts add 39 videos. The four whose twins are guide excerpts (hop-9857, hop-9860, hop-9865 and hop-9867) are linked to the same episodes as excerpts; coverage is unchanged. Three same-title pairs embed different videos. The first version's estimate that about 15 music posts repeat show posts is superseded by this comparison.
